summary: Without an injected stall the Big Tam failure is NOT reproducible on this box (SIGKILL lands in microseconds; drained tail ~500-730KB or ~65KB for yes), so a naive perl-enlarged-pipe or /usr/bin/yes test would be FALSE-GREEN on a fast box (base 0-2/100). A deterministic, sleep-free, perl-free variant was RED 100/100 on base, GREEN 0/100 on HEAD: awk emits 600 lines + 12000 y, then the child touches a marker file; on_line polls the marker (bounded 10s) at the 500th line before the latch; total output 13.2KB < 16KiB macOS pipe so the child never blocks. Relies on on_line running on the runner thread. perl is used by no test and no workflow in the repo, so a perl test would be a new unguaranteed dependency. Optional.
